name: Halifax Independent School

geo.coord_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocode of the official address (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), 2026-10-30 — school building match

description: Small progressive independent school in Halifax (pre-primary to Grade 9), founded in 1974 as Dalhousie University's laboratory school; hands-on inquiry ('Theme') alongside a core curriculum.

attributes.philosophy: Progressive, holistic, whole-child; hands-on inquiry through 'Theme' study; three outdoor play times a day.

legal_status.label: Private (independent) school, Nova Scotia — elementary/middle; not on the province's list of schools granting the High School Leaving Certificate
legal_status.authority: Nova Scotia Department of Education and Early Childhood Development

attributes.curriculum: Core curriculum with inquiry-based Theme study.

tuition.notes: 2026-27: Pre-primary $13,805; Elementary (Primary–6) $15,880; Middle (7–9) $17,175; initial admission fee $2,500 (new families); EAL support $1,600 where assessed. Fee cards were parsed from page text; card-to-amount mapping (Pre-primary → $13,805, Elementary → $15,880, Middle → $17,175) should be re-checked visually.

attributes.additional_fees: Application $100 (Canadian/PR or work/study-permit holder), $300 international; initial admission fee $2,500.
advantages: Moderate fees for a city independent school
Application fee policy explicitly covers work/study-permit families
limitations: Inquiry model is partial: a core curriculum runs alongside Theme study
No public provincial register of private elementary schools found to confirm registration
attributes.qualifying_reason: Tuition and model read on the official site, but (1) the model is a progressive blend rather than a clearly distinct alternative and (2) Nova Scotia publishes no list of private elementary schools, so legal status could not be confirmed against a register.

sources.title: Going to School in Nova Scotia
sources.publisher: Nova Scotia Department of Education and Early Childhood Development

verification.notes: Legal status not confirmable against a public register.
